notablePrerequisites: Ley Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, causing all creatures you control to have base power and toughness 1/1 and gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate any land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping it and the land.
Repeat from step 2.
